summary: security checked in 2 executive handoff item(s)

items.summary: Disposition: evidence_needed for fleet-wide security clearance; blocked for public exposure and security-sensitive releases; conditional for ordinary reversible growth. Evidence: fleet-doctor has no run or control results; operations deploy-health, uptime, and error sweeps have no results; authentication and access boundaries, secrets handling, container isolation, release approvals and provenance, dependency and supply-chain controls, data exposure, monitoring, incident response, complete TLS posture, and security.txt/disclosure readiness remain unverified. No certificates are reported expiring within 30 days, but this does not establish complete TLS coverage. Compliance is technical-only with 37 passes, 15 failures, and 7 unknowns; data quality reports analytics as yellow with source permission or collector issues. Risk severity is high for public exposure and security-sensitive releases, medium for bounded growth. Exact decision: preserve private launch gates, allow only bounded reversible growth that adds no credentials, permissions, dependencies, data collection, or cross-site behavior, and continue the existing read-only security evidence matrix. Do not access credentials or private containers, change permissions or configuration, exploit targets, add dependencies, deploy, requeue failures, or conduct external outreach.

Retain the existing bounded fleet security evidence matrix. Record dated, redacted evidence, affected scope, owners, explicit unknowns, severity, and release implications for authentication and access boundaries, secrets exposure, runtime isolation, release and deployment controls, dependency provenance, TLS, data exposure, monitoring, incident readiness, and disclosure readiness. Do not create duplicate requests or production work.
